key_insight: The paper proposes NP-DNN, a hybrid model that combines Neural Prophet's time-series decomposition with a deep neural network to produce more accurate and probabilistic stock price forecasts. This approach aims to better capture trend/seasonality and complex non-linear patterns while providing prediction intervals.
problem_solved: Addresses the inability of many traditional time-series methods to effectively forecast the probability range (uncertainty) of future stock prices and to capture complex non-linear market dynamics.
method: Hybrid architecture: integrate Neural Prophet (trend, seasonality, and changepoint modeling) with a Deep Neural Network that models residual non-linear patterns.
Train the combined model end-to-end to produce point forecasts plus probabilistic prediction intervals, improving uncertainty estimation.
Use time-series preprocessing and backtesting on historical stock data to validate forecast reliability and interval coverage.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a practical hybrid modeling pattern for financial time-series that balances interpretable components (trend/seasonality) with deep models for complex signals, improving decision-making where forecast uncertainty matters (risk management, trading strategies).
visual_elements: Time-series plot showing historical prices, point forecast, and shaded prediction intervals (before vs after NP-DNN).
Simplified model diagram: Neural Prophet block -> residuals -> Deep Neural Network block -> combined forecast.
Bar or table comparing forecast interval coverage and error metrics (e.g., RMSE, MAE) across baseline vs NP-DNN.
Flowchart of training and backtesting pipeline (data preprocessing, train/validation splits, evaluation).
paper_title: Stock Market Price Prediction using Neural Prophet with Deep Neural Network
paper_authors: Navin Chhibber, Suneel Khemka, Navneet Kumar Tyagi, Rohit Tewari, Bireswar Banerjee
